instruction: Please enlarge the mouse cursor to improve its visibility on the screen.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: CURSOR_SIZE=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CURSOR_SIZE" ] && [ "$CURSOR_SIZE" -gt 24 ]; then echo "Large cursor enabled (size: $CURSOR_SIZE)"; else echo "No large cursor enabled (size: $CURSOR_SIZE)"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing cursor size for better visibility. Evaluator checks if cursor-size is greater than 24 (default is usually 24) using gsettings. Similar difficulty to original task - both are single accessibility settings. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary score: 1.0 if cursor size > 24, 0.0 otherwise
